Chapter 398: Chapter 13: The Reopening Of Seven Star Cave World (Subscription Requested)

Chapter 398: Chapter 13: The Reopening of Seven Star Cave World (Subscription Requested)

“Magic Jade Tower ordinary member?”

“Magic Jade Tower?”

Lin Yuan was shocked in his heart. Had he joined the Magic Jade Tower without realizing it?

To fully comprehend all 3,333 Evolution Paths… Lin Yuan found it inconceivable. He had merely comprehended them, without actually cultivating any. How could the other party be aware that he had done so?

“Magic Jade Tower…”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts fluctuated.

...

At the level he was currently at, he was somewhat familiar with the famous clans and powers of the Main World.

Even if he didn’t fully understand them, he definitely had heard of them to some extent. However, before today, he had never heard of the three words ‘Magic Jade Tower’.

“Could it be related to the owner of this segment of the body, a power from outside the Main World?”

Lin Yuan silently mused to himself.

To become an ordinary member of the Magic Jade Tower, one must comprehend all 3,333 Evolution Paths contained within that segment of the body. It was easy to associate this body segment with the ‘Magic Jade Tower’.

“Such a method…”

Lin Yuan admired in his heart. He had originally thought that the greatest fortune of this corpse, over which several Supreme Beings fought and killed each other to snatch, was that Supreme Evolution Path.

But now it seemed that becoming a member of the Magic Jade Tower was the ultimate benefit.

“Magic Jade Tower? Why is ‘demon’ part of its name?”

The clear murmur Lin Yuan had heard was not in any language he knew, yet he was able to inexplicably understand its meaning.

And the name ‘Magic Jade Tower’ didn’t seem to denote any sort of positive force.

Also, if the Supreme Being’s corpse that drifted in from the Eternal Spatial Rift was related to the Magic Jade Tower, why was it dead?

Many questions flickered through Lin Yuan’s mind.

“Magic Jade Mark…”

Lin Yuan began to carefully observe his soul.

After understanding all 3,333 Evolution Paths, these paths underwent a bizarre transformation, condensing into what is called the ‘Magic Jade Mark’, which automatically made Lin Yuan an ordinary member of the Magic Jade Tower.

So, that ‘Magic Jade Mark’ must be the key.

Lin Yuan recalled that in the end, this mark had merged into the depths of his soul.

“Found it.”

Lin Yuan quickly located a ‘Nine Floors Dark Tower’ mark in the depths of his soul.

“Hmm?”

When Lin Yuan’s consciousness merged with this mark, he immediately received a vast amount of information.

“So that’s how it is…”

Lin Yuan appeared to be in deep thought.

There were two ways to become a member of the Magic Jade Tower.

The first method was to cultivate any one of the comprehended Evolution Paths.

Each Evolution Path contained within that body segment had its massive defects and hidden dangers.

Cultivating it and completely compensating for its defects, overcoming countless difficulties, one could automatically become an ordinary member of the Magic Jade Tower.

The second method was to follow Lin Yuan’s approach, where, without cultivating, simply comprehending all 3,333 Evolution Paths would trigger a certain threshold, condensing the Magic Jade Mark and automatically granting membership to the Magic Jade Tower.

These two approaches mainly comprised two types of tests.

The former tested whether an Evolver could overcome numerous difficulties when faced with a thorny path and eventually reach the end.

The latter tested the Evolver’s comprehension abilities and Spirit Will.

You should know that only by comprehending, without cultivating, one would continue to face pressure on their Spirit Will.

To still be able to comprehend all 3,333 Evolution Paths under such conditions, and if the time consumed did not exceed a hundred thousand years, then the comprehension ability of the individual could be described as terrifying. The Magic Jade Tower would very much welcome such Evolvers to join.

“The owner of this body segment must have been a Supreme Being from the Magic Jade Tower.”

“It’s just unknown for what reason he fell, and his physical body carried so many ‘faulty’ Evolution Paths of the Magic Jade Tower…”

“Perhaps ‘carrying’ isn’t the right word, rather this Supreme Being had been cultivating them himself, that’s why we could comprehend them…”

Lin Yuan deduced in his heart.

“And there’s this ‘Magic Jade Mark’…”

With the help of this mark, Lin Yuan faintly sensed a mysterious space.

This Mysterious Space was not in the Main World, and the ‘Magic Jade Mark’ was like a key, allowing Lin Yuan entrance whenever he wished.

At the same time.

Lin Yuan received a warning.

“Do not venture into the Demon Jade Space until you reach the Eighth Layer limit!”

…

“Demon Jade Space?”

“One has to reach the Eighth Layer limit to go in?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself that although his Inner World had reached over a hundred thousand miles in radius and could be said to be not much weaker than an Eighth Layer limit Evolver,

who knew what the Demon Jade Space tested? What if it wasn’t the Inner World?

Therefore—

Even though Lin Yuan was extremely curious about the Demon Jade Space,

he also felt that he should obediently wait until reaching the Eighth Layer limit before considering exploration.

Considering Lin Yuan’s cultivation speed, reaching the Eighth Layer limit wouldn’t take too long anyway.

…

“Condensing the Magic Jade Mark did not attract the attention of others?”

Lin Yuan opened his eyes and looked around, noting that the other Evolvers were still diligently comprehending that segment of the body. From time to time, some Evolvers’ bodies collapsed, and soon new Evolvers replaced them.

“Can I continue to comprehend?”

Lin Yuan looked towards the body segment and discovered it was still challenging them to comprehend more Evolution Paths.

“I can feel that my speed of comprehension has increased, and my Spirit Will has also improved to a certain degree. Is it because of that ‘Magic Jade Mark’?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The Magic Jade Mark did not merely act as a key, but it also stabilized Lin Yuan’s soul or even his Spirit Will, akin to a Sea-Calming Divine Needle, almost equivalent to having an Eighth Layer Soul Defense Type Treasure to guard it.

“This is too incredible.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly. A mere mark could achieve the effects of an Eighth Layer Soul Defense Treasure? The origins of the Magic Jade Tower were definitely beyond imagination.
